contract.task_clause:
It is known that a lab cart is moving east at 25 cm/s at time t1 = 0.10 s, and then moving east at 15 cm/s at t2 = 0.20 s. Is this enough information to determine the direction of the net force acting on the cart between t1 and t2?
Option A: Yes, since we know the cart is slowing down, its momentum change is opposite the direction of movement, and the net force is in the direction of momentum change.
Option B: No, because we don’t know whether forces such as friction or air resistance might be acting on the cart.
Option C: No, because we don’t know the mass of the cart.
Option D: Yes, since we know the cart keeps moving to the east, the net force must be in the direction of motion.
